title: Best Gyms in Auckland 2026 — City-by-City Guide with Prices
meta_desc: Compare Auckland gym prices and find the best gym for you in 2026
intro: Aucklanders have numerous gym options to choose from, with prices ranging from $10 to $50 per week. With so many options, it can be challenging to decide which gym is best for you. This guide will help you make an informed decision.

sections.heading: Auckland Gym Options by Suburb
sections.body: Auckland has various gym options across different suburbs, including CBD, North Shore, and South Auckland. Some popular gyms in Auckland include Anytime Fitness, Jetts, and City Fitness.

sections.heading: Price Comparison of Popular Gyms in Auckland
Commuter Gyms in Auckland
sections.body: For those who work in the CBD, there are several gym options available. City Fitness and Les Mills have multiple locations in the CBD, with prices starting from $29.95 and $49.95 per week, respectively.

sections.heading: Gym Options with Parking in Auckland
list: Anytime Fitness - multiple locations with free parking
Jetts - some locations with free parking, including Newmarket and Pakuranga
City Fitness - paid parking available at some locations
